"""risk.returns.log_returns at its spine version: simple returns."""

from __future__ import annotations

import pytest

from mdata import Prices
from risk.returns import log_returns


def _prices() -> Prices:
    return Prices(
        dates=("2024-03-04", "2024-03-05", "2024-03-06"),
        tickers=("AAPL", "MSFT"),
        closes={"AAPL": (100.0, 110.0, 99.0), "MSFT": (200.0, 200.0, 250.0)},
    )


def test_dates_follow_the_base_date():
    returns = log_returns(_prices())
    assert returns.base_date == "2024-03-04"
    assert returns.dates == ("2024-03-05", "2024-03-06")
    assert returns.tickers == ("AAPL", "MSFT")


def test_one_simple_return_per_date():
    returns = log_returns(_prices())
    assert returns.values["AAPL"] == pytest.approx((0.1, -0.1))
    assert returns.values["MSFT"] == pytest.approx((0.0, 0.25))


def test_fewer_than_two_dates_is_an_error():
    prices = Prices(dates=("2024-03-04",), tickers=("AAPL",), closes={"AAPL": (100.0,)})
